capabilities: Drag paragraphs, headings, quotes, callouts and code blocks to new positions
Move list items together with their nested children
Swap adjacent sections at the same level after a preview
Convert blocks to headings, bullets, tasks, quotes or callouts
Copy block links and extract blocks into new notes
disambiguation: Not a dice or TTRPG tool; the six dots are a drag handle for reordering Markdown blocks.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; install manually from GitHub Releases. Mobile support is an early preview and Windows/Linux verification is pending. Reading view is out of scope. Free, with optional tips; interface is English or Chinese only.
problem: Reordering paragraphs, list items or whole sections in Obsidian means cutting and pasting, which easily breaks nested list content and heading structure.

relations.evidence: SixDots brings Notion-style block actions to Obsidian.

summary: Adds a six-dot handle beside Markdown blocks for dragging them into a new order and running quick block actions.
